fixedProjection.notRunner: The string documents the future runner's required projection only. This batch never executes it, chooses an input path, uses read_intervals, merges stderr or establishes process exit success. Fixtures are in-memory bytes; arbitrary source media, URLs, tags and raw payload dumps are excluded.
fixedProjection.rows: Every nonempty LF-terminated line starts packet|. Accept LF or exactly one CR immediately before LF; reject all other CR. Root's actual fixed candidate projection emitted57736bytes/366CRLF rows,exit0,empty stderr, so a blanket CR rejection would reject Windows FFprobe. Count both newline bytes against limits. Accept exactly seven mandatory unique keys in any order: stream_index, pts, dts, duration, size, flags, data_hash. No tag, pos, decimal *_time, stream, format, ERROR or arbitrary section. Reject duplicate/missing/unknown keys, backslash/escaped delimiters, NUL/non-ASCII and unterminated final rows. Known fixed values need no escaping; no general compact-text parser.
fixedProjection.values: stream_index is0..31 and must map to an explicit supplied track; PTS/DTS are signed i64 decimal except AV_NOPTS_VALUE; duration is a positive i64; size1..33554432. No N/A, signs on unsigned fields, exponent, float, whitespace trimming or saturating conversion. flags are exactly three positions K-or-underscore, D-or-underscore, C-or-underscore; D/C rows are unsupported evidence, never silently retained as ordinary media. data_hash is exactly SHA256: plus64 ASCII hex digits, decoded into32 bytes.
fixedProjection.sideData: Only zero side-data fields or exactly this complete unique group is recognized: side_datum/skip_samples:side_data_type=Skip Samples; side_datum/skip_samples:skip_samples; side_datum/skip_samples:discard_padding; side_datum/skip_samples:skip_reason; side_datum/skip_samples:discard_reason. Counts are u32, reasons u8. This exact prefix was observed from the pinned executable. Incomplete/repeated groups and every other side-data type/prefix fail unsupported, including a bare side_data_type guess. Preserve None versus an explicit zero-valued group distinctly; a source/output change is a mismatch. Parsing known Skip Samples is not approval to trim audio. Runner omission of all side-data options cannot be detected from a plain row, so later exact runner/projection provenance remains mandatory.

boundedPureApi.shape: One incremental line decoder accepts borrowed byte chunks and emits a typed PacketFact synchronously. A per-track Fold consumes facts without retaining rows. A separate PairComparison consumes one source/output packet pair in per-track ordinal order, plus supplied source/output time bases and a common-origin value. A pure iterator fixture helper checks both iterators end together; no async queues or generalized I/O framework.
boundedPureApi.caps: At most128KiB per supplied chunk,2048bytes per LF-terminated row,12keys,20,000,000 packet rows and4GiB textual input per decoder/fold; per-track payload total at most128GiB. Integer time-base numerator/denominator each1..1,000,000,000. Immutable private limits; smaller test limits allowed only under cfg(test). First failure permanently latches; feed/finish after terminal completion or failure rejects. Empty streams are not successful evidence.
boundedPureApi.memory: One bounded line, one typed packet during callback, at most two fixed track folds and one pair being compared. No Vec of packet rows, unlimited strings, hash maps, inter-stream backlog or collected tool output. Track mapping is supplied separately and fixed before input; unexpected stream IDs fail. Mixed input may be folded but must not be queued for pairing. Future runner must arrange per-track ordinal pairing, for example independent fixed stream projections, without dropping any inspected packets.
boundedPureApi.fold: Version/domain-separated SHA256 over each ordinal, payload size,32-byte payload hash, key flag and closed side-data representation; track kind and final count/byte total bind the result. Retain only checked counters, first/last/min/max integer times and a streaming hash. Source and output stream indexes may differ through an explicit mapping; they do not substitute for track identity. Ordered-fold equality is probabilistic hash evidence, not a claim that source bytes were independently re-read or that packet timing is valid.
boundedPureApi.errors: Closed enums only: invalid_row, unsupported_side_data, unsupported_flags, invalid_value, bounds, unknown_stream, truncated, empty, count_mismatch, payload_mismatch, flags_mismatch, side_data_mismatch, arithmetic_overflow, terminal. Never include rejected line text, paths, media payload, secrets or dynamic tool errors. No diagnostics or report persistence in this module.

rationalComparison.inputs: Validated positive Rational time bases and one explicit signed Rational common origin. Source PTS/DTS multiply by source time base, then subtract that same origin; output uses output time base. Duration comparison has no origin subtraction. The module does not infer offsets, independently zero tracks, decide a start RAP, select/trim packets or treat native receipt time as media time.
rationalComparison.arithmetic: Use reduced checked i128 rational arithmetic with positive denominator and gcd cancellation before multiplication/addition; overflow is a fixed failure, never float fallback or wrapping. Normalize sign and zero. No floating point controls equality. Avoid a generic reusable math framework; only local multiply, subtract, absolute difference and comparison operations needed by this verifier.
rationalComparison.result: For each paired ordinal require identical size/payload hash, key flag and side-data representation. Accumulate exact maximum absolute rational PTS, DTS and duration errors plus ordinal/count. Report those facts and the source/output tick sizes, not a boolean clockVerified/mediaVerified. A later independently reviewed retained-packet plan must decide permissible rescaling and coverage; this batch has no caller-provided arbitrary epsilon and no blanket1ms tolerance.
rationalComparison.completeness: One matching pair, one equal aggregate count, successful EOF parsing or a tool's decode exit0 cannot establish whole-track equivalence. Fixture helper exhausts both sources, requires equal nonzero count, no parser error and every ordered pair comparison. Inputs must already represent an explicitly selected retained range; skipped prefix/tail and their hashes are the future planner's responsibility. Codec/color/extradata equivalence and actual process exit/full decode remain outside this module.
